Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
If I have Inscribed a Theft of Vitae onto a vampire, and that vampire is in
combat with Watenda, and decides to strike with the Theft... can Watenda
cancel that card?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No. The effect cannot be canceled by effects that cancel card plays.
It is not a card play.
